'''[[Reflections Gold]]''' contains 310 surviving card designs. Original playtest scans and enhanced reconstructions by Andy Talaga appear below.<ref name="c1">[https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398 Category One buylist]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210909114037/https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MgdLgCSaNFWN46hCrVhFNDv4fzrJ0jKe Internet Archive]</ref>
